Find the area of $△ABC$. Round your answer to two decimal places.
question.:question/worked-solution:
The formula for the area of the triangle is 

$$
A=\frac{1}{2}bc\operatorname{sin}⁡A,
$$

where $∠A$ is between the sides of lengths $b$ and $c.$ 

Here, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}c & =AB=10.6, \\ b & =AC=4.9, \\ m∠A & ={116}^{∘}.\end{aligned}
$$

Since 

$$
\operatorname{sin}⁡{116}^{∘}=0.898\,794,
$$

rounded to six decimal places,  we calculate the area as follows:
 

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot 4.9\cdot 10.6\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡{116}^{∘} \\  & =25.97\cdot (0.898\,794) \\  & ≈23.34,\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to two decimal places.
